comment: Golden canonical CBOR (RFC 8949 §4.2.1) for hord-core objects. `hex` is the expected encoding; `object_id` is BLAKE3-256 of those bytes. Blob bytes are CBOR major type 2.

blob.name: deadbeef
blob.comment: Blob { bytes: h'deadbeef' }. Keys: bytes. Payload is bstr 0x44deadbeef, not an integer array.

snapshot.name: zero-meta-null-index
snapshot.comment: Snapshot { tree: 32-byte 0x11, metadata.toolchain: null, index.identity/edges: null }. Map keys sort as tree, index, metadata (encoded-key order).
